unit_materialization_rule: Each row is one parse unit; locators retain same-path/same-standing implementation distinctions without cross-file synthesis.

units.normalized_content: Declares ARC package architecture Gamma→attribution→confidence→permission→allocation→correction→RI→C_future, separates ARC control from RAHU evaluation, imports six ARC subpackages and declares version 0.1.0.
Declares baseline, oracle and learned agent package and attempts exports ARCBaseAgent, FlatOptimizer, MetaLearner, ARCLite, ARCController and OracleReset.

ARC-Full source intends learned failure diagnosis, confidence gating, permission/allocation and bounded intervention over parameter/representation/operator/ontology; holding returns zero intervention; evaluate currently returns zeros for AE_w, retention, RI and C_future.
Runtime metric evaluation is explicitly described as a placeholder and does not provide measured ARC metrics.

Implements oracle-attribution ARC-Lite: accepts optional ground-truth failure label, returns one-hot confidence-1 posterior, full permission, failed-layer allocation and bounded intervention; evaluate returns static 1.0 values as theoretical ceiling.

Defines generic state fields parameters/representation/metadata, diagnostic/intervention dataclasses, abstract observe/diagnose/permission/allocation/intervene/evaluate contract, and step pipeline calling those methods in order.

Parameter-only baseline: fixed parameter attribution, permission 1, parameter allocation, learning-rate intervention, static zero evaluation outputs; docstrings predict shallow strength and deep-shock weakness rather than report results.

Meta-learning baseline uses fixed posterior .60/.25/.10/.05, fixed strategy plasticity .5, fixed allocation .70/.20/.08/.02, parameter intervention and static metric profile .25/.40/.35/.40; source labels benchmark profile as expected.

Defines impossible perfect-information OracleResetAgent with perfect given-label attribution, full permission, one-layer allocation, full intervention and static all-1 evaluation outputs as theoretical upper bound.
Declares attribution stage E_t→P(L_i|E_t) and exports FailureLayer, FailurePosterior, AttributionEngine and attribution_confidence.
Implements FA_c as maximum posterior probability plus threshold and low-confidence holding predicates.

Defines five-layer parameter/representation/rule/world-model/ontology enum and posterior; current AttributionEngine is a heuristic uniform prior with +0.1 parameter weight when discrepancy>0, normalized; source names more advanced future attribution methods.
Current heuristic is explicitly a baseline; causal localization validity is not established.

Alternative four-layer theta/representation/grammar/ontology failure model with priors .40/.30/.20/.10; heuristically rescales priors using error/persistence/transfer/representation/rule signals and maps posterior to depth .25/.50/.75/1.00.
Source explicitly leaves neural, causal-graph and learned attribution models for future versions.
Defines five-layer theta/M/G_O/C/Omega hierarchy, fixed depth/dependency/irreversibility/cost metadata, weighted regime-depth calculation and stored intervention cost lookup.
Declares external evaluation layer for attribution accuracy, retention, RI and phase boundary and attempts exports weighted_attribution_accuracy, structural_retention and recovery_intelligence.
Implements AE_w as one minus weighted absolute depth error over weighted true depth, clamped to [0,1], plus unweighted attribution distance and max-posterior confidence.
Depth-distance score is implemented but not validated as a measure of causal attribution accuracy.
Defines C_future proxy from retained structure, available actions, correction accuracy and exploration capacity; default equal-weight composite; provides non-decrease predicate and delta.
Composite operationalizes a candidate proxy; empirical identification of future adaptive capacity is not established.

Defines phase points carrying D_R/B_D/F_S/AAR/ARC/baseline scores, classifies AAR around 1 with .05 tolerance, computes score separation and finds first supplied AAR>=1 point with positive ARC advantage.
No phase points or observed crossover are contained in the file.
Defines RI inputs and computes RI=(DeltaV×S_retained×AE_w)/(structural_damage+adaptation_cost+epsilon); classifies collapse, survival_without_intelligence and arc_adaptation by thresholds.
Formula defines a metric but does not validate RI as recovery intelligence.
Implements numerical retention as fraction of old tasks whose post-performance meets prior performance within tolerance, symbolic set retention, and evaluator wrapper.
These are bounded preservation proxies and do not identify all intended structural capital.

Defines in-memory ARC telemetry fields for Gamma, attribution, AAR, permission, allocation, intervention and evaluation metrics; records/exports events, extracts metric series and checks non-decreasing recorded C_future.
Declares governor separation of permission, allocation and correction and attempts exports for permission, permeability and intervention-cost objects.
Defines AAR components and arithmetic AAR*=blast-radius-prevented/(diagnostic-overhead+intervention-risk), >1 advantage predicate and distance from boundary.
The arithmetic is defined but empirical estimators for the three AAR components are not.
Implements DeltaS_i=lambda_A×Pi_A×max_update after permission/allocation validation, sums total change and detects near-zero permission holding.
Class-based permeability implementation weights posterior×FA_c×AAR/cost and normalizes, with input validation for posterior, confidence and AAR.
Implements logistic lambda_A=sigmoid(k1(FA_c-tau_c)+k2(AAR-1)+k3Gamma), a stateful controller and confidence-threshold holding predicate.
Defines stable, conservative and holding states; defaults confidence .8 and AAR thresholds; low confidence→holding, sufficient confidence+AAR>=1→stable, else conservative; multipliers 1/.25/0.
Declares structural permeability as bounded post-diagnosis allocation and attempts exports allocation, intervention cost and normalization helpers.
Function-based permeability computes P(failure)×FA_c×AAR/cost, normalizes or returns zeros, and selects dominant layer.
Defines four-layer theta/representation/grammar/ontology cost table 1/3/7/15 with increasing irreversibility, normalized-cost and cost×(1+irreversibility) resistance helpers.
Static intervention-cost and irreversibility constants are encoded without empirical identification.
Computes per-layer interventions DeltaS_i=lambda_A×Pi_A×DeltaS_max, supports magnitude filtering and total intervention magnitude.
Normalizes allocation scores, accepts zero/no-allocation budget, validates sum≈1 and rescales when exceeding maximum budget.
Declares reality layer as environmental-evidence generation without adaptation choice and exports RealityCoupling and EnvironmentalEvidence.
Implements mismatch signal and threshold invalidation; default error is numeric absolute difference or equality mismatch, with optional custom error function.
Discrepancy-threshold code is a proxy and does not establish unique identification of external invalidation/reality coupling.
Defines structured prediction/observation/discrepancy evidence with timestamp/context/features, threshold significance, serializable description and constructor.
